resubscribe_missing.title: Resubscribe missing items
resubscribe_missing.message:
This will process {count} Workshop items that are still subscribed but missing local files.

The manager will first send unsubscribe requests to Steam and wait for success, then subscribe again so Steam can fetch these items again.

Because Steam client and network state are outside the manager's control, unsubscribe may succeed while resubscribe fails, downloads may queue for a long time, or list refresh may be delayed. After running this, wait for Steam downloads to complete, then refresh inventory or scan again.
resubscribe_missing.success: Resubscribe requests sent for {count} missing items. Wait for Steam downloads to finish.

download_missing.title: Download missing items with Steam
download_missing.message:
This will process {count} Workshop items that are still subscribed but missing local files.

This will not unsubscribe them. It directly asks the Steam client to redownload or verify these items, then waits in the task bar until Steam confirms the local files are downloaded.

If Steam network is unavailable, downloads stay queued too long, or the item itself is unavailable, the task will fail.

general.smooth_target_scroll_desc: When enabled, locating search results or moved items scrolls smoothly to the target. When disabled, the list jumps directly.

features.action_prechecks_desc: When enabled, saving, launching, and auto-sorting check for uninstalled and unactived items first. When disabled, actions run directly without the check dialog.
features.auto_scan_on_startup_desc: When disabled, you need to click the scan button manually to update the Mod list.
features.auto_sort_logic_desc: Controls the overall auto-sort strategy, ordering within the same tier, and dependency clustering.
features.auto_sort_strategy_desc: Legacy is more conservative and closer to traditional manual ordering, but handles top/bottom-biased mods and their related chains less effectively. The new strategy more aggressively pushes top/bottom-biased mods and their chains toward both ends of the list.
features.backup_retention_days_desc: Controls how long automatic backups are kept. Manual backups are not affected.
features.check_language_support_desc: When enabled, Mod issue hints include a language support warning showing whether a Mod supports the current language.
features.coexist_folder_name_type_desc: Controls folder names for coexisting Mods. Priority is alias > original name > package ID > Workshop ID, so Mods without aliases can still use their original name.
features.default_translation_settings_desc: Translation features without their own language or provider settings use these defaults.
features.delete_missing_mods_data_desc: When disabled, missing Mod data is kept in the database so you can resubscribe from the list.
features.enable_tool_mods_desc: When enabled, helper tool mods, such as log collection helpers, are automatically activated while saving or auto-sorting.
features.file_generation_deploy_desc: Controls coexisting Mod folder naming and link deployment before launch.
features.file_size_scan_desc: When enabled, scans automatically check Mod file sizes to detect new or updated content. This increases scan time but significantly improves file change detection.
features.language_packs_follow_targets: Place language packs next to targets
features.language_packs_follow_targets_desc: When enabled, auto-sort tries to place language packs after their last actived prerequisite or dependency. If no target is found, the original default lower position is kept.
features.launch_profile_quick_scan: Check sync before direct profile launch
features.launch_profile_quick_scan_desc: When launching a non-current profile directly from the profile list, required links are checked and synced first. When enabled, a lightweight scan runs before syncing; when disabled, sync is forced from the current database cache and profile config.
features.link_deployment_mode_desc: Controls link deployment when using manager Mods or Workshop Mods across profiles. Incremental deployment keeps correct existing links and only processes changes. Full rebuild removes all old links first, then recreates them from the current scan result.
features.list_action_checks_desc: Controls reminders and helper behavior while saving, launching, and displaying lists.
features.mod_residue_scan_desc: When enabled, a full scan checks in the background for folders and settings left after uninstalls. When disabled, residues are checked only when you open residue cleanup manually.
features.multiplayer_compatibility_check_desc: When enabled, if Multiplayer is found in the inventory, the Mod list shows compatibility levels and helper fix hints.
features.persist_temp_mod_list_desc: When enabled, the temporary list is saved per profile and restored next time you enter that profile. When disabled, Mods in the temporary list are returned to the top of the deactivated list when saving.
features.regular_mods_follow_dependencies_desc: When enabled, auto-sort tries to place regular Mods after the last actived dependency within the same weight tier, keeping related series closer together.
features.scan_maintenance_desc: Controls Mod list refresh, file change detection, and missing data handling.
features.show_coexistence_message_desc: When disabled, coexisting Mod conflict hints are not shown.
features.skip_language_pack_alias_generation: Skip alias notes for language packs
features.skip_language_pack_alias_generation_desc: When enabled, batch alias and note generation skips language packs. Manual generation for a single Mod is not affected.
features.sort_mods_by_desc: Affects Mod order within the same tier during auto-sort. Priority is alias > original name > package ID, so Mods without aliases can still be sorted by original name.
features.startup_prompt_new_only: Only warn about new startup issues
features.startup_prompt_new_only_desc: When enabled, startup inventory reminders show only newly found changes, missing items, and deleted items. When disabled, existing unresolved issues continue to be shown.
features.strict_disabled_mode_desc: When enabled, scans keep Mods deactivated according to manager records. Mods reactivated externally are automatically deactivated again. Manual deactivation removal is not affected.
features.title: Feature settings
features.translation_desc: Set default translation preferences and separate behavior for Workshop description translation.
features.workshop_description_translation_desc: Set the language, provider, and auto-translation strategy for Workshop detail descriptions.
features.workshop_description_translation_only_de: Only affects title and description translation on Workshop detail pages.

external.auto_data_update_check_desc: Check rules, Workshop database, replacement database, Multiplayer compatibility data, and Git recommendation list updates at the configured interval.
external.auto_tool_check_desc: Check at the configured interval whether external tools such as SteamCMD and todds are missing or not ready.

external.data_libraries_desc: Sources, paths, and update checks for external data files such as rules, Workshop database, and replacement database.

external.instead_db_url_desc: Replacement Mod database used to hint removed, remade, or recommended replacement items. Source: community cache file.
external.mp_compat_package_ids_path_desc: Local cache file for the Multiplayer Compatibility support list.
external.mp_compat_package_ids_url_desc: Support list from Multiplayer Compatibility, used to mark Mods that can be fixed by the helper Mod. Source: source-code parsing.
external.multiplayer_compatibility_path_desc: Local cache file for the Multiplayer compatibility table.
external.multiplayer_compatibility_url_desc: Multiplayer compatibility-level table used to show online compatibility status. Source: official endpoint.
external.ripgrep_path_desc: ripgrep tool directory used first for file content search. Choose the folder containing rg.exe.
external.silent_data_update_desc: When enabled, automatically detected external library updates are refreshed directly without asking. Manual checks still ask for confirmation.
external.silent_data_update_disabled_desc: Enable automatic external library update checks first.
external.steamcmd_path_desc: SteamCMD directory used by the manager to download and update Workshop Mods. Choose the folder containing steamcmd.exe.
external.texture_tools_path_desc: todds tool directory used for texture optimization. Choose the folder containing todds.exe.
external.title: External dependencies
external.tools_desc: External program configuration and status checks for tools called by the manager, such as SteamCMD and texture tools.
external.user_rules_path_desc: Local user rules file used to save custom sorting, dependency, and conflict rules.
external.workshop_db_path_desc: Local cache file for the Workshop information database.
external.workshop_db_url_desc: Workshop information database used to supplement Mod names, authors, and descriptions. Source: community cache file.

network.enable_proxy_desc:
Enable proxy service. All network requests will go through the proxy server. Some external data downloads, update checks, description image loading, built-in browser access, and similar features may need this to work.

You can also configure a global network environment outside the app.
network.enable_steam_enhanced_api_desc: After enabling and filling in the Key, Workshop pages prefer online enhanced information. Without a Key or when disabled, local cache search is used automatically.
network.steam_web_api_key_desc: The Key is stored securely in the local credential vault. Without a Key, search automatically falls back to the cache.
network.steam_web_api_key_help: After enabling and filling in the Key, Steam Web API is used to fetch more complete Workshop search, collection search, author works, and dependency relationship information. When disabled, the local cached Workshop database is still available.
network.steam_web_api_key_risk: Anyone who obtains this Key can silently cancel a player's real trades without triggering Steam Guard, and replace them with fake trades sent to a scammer. Never share your API key with anyone or any unverified third-party website.
network.steam_web_api_key_warning: Warning: your API key is effectively a backdoor key to your Steam account. It can read public account data/inventory information and manage or listen to trade offers.
network.title: Network protocol and proxy
network.use_proxy_on_ai_desc: When enabled, AI requests go through the proxy server. Do not enable this if the configured endpoint is already a local/domestic proxy.
network.use_proxy_on_steamcmd_desc:
Whether SteamCMD uses the proxy server.

When enabled, SteamCMD download, update, and install operations go through the proxy server.

backup_list.rules:
**[[Automatic and manual backups]]**
^^Short-term backups:^^ After each save or run action, the current config file is backed up when it changed. Short-term backups are kept for 1 day by default, cleaned on startup, and only the latest daily backup is kept as a long-term backup.
^^Long-term backups:^^ Automatic long-term backups are kept for the last 30 days by default. Expired files are removed.
^^Manual backups:^^ Manually created backups are saved to the selected directory and are not removed automatically.
__Automatic list backup format: RML_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.rml__
__Manual export support: ModsConfig.xml / ModList.rml__

group_list.help:
**Group management**
Drag mods from lists into any group.
Right-click a list to quickly move mods into or out of existing groups.
On the mod details page, you can manage all groups that contain that mod.

Groups work like a clipboard. Moving into or out of groups is a [[copy]] operation:
 - ^^Removing^^ from a group does not remove the mod itself;
 - Dragging mods between groups copies them and skips members already in the target group.

Whole groups can also be dragged:
 - Drag a group into the activated list to activate every mod in it;
 - Drag a group into the deactivated list to deactivate every mod in it.

mod_rule_editor.language_owner: Detected owners come from backend analysis by default. You can set owners manually. The right-side switch controls override or merge mode: when override is on, user owners replace detected owners; when off, they are merged with detected owners.

rule_panel.priority: Rule priority affects autosort and issue detection decisions.
rule_panel.weight:
**Mod weight rules**
Normal mods use weight 500 by default.
“Set weight” accepts 1-999. Smaller values sort earlier.
“Shift weight” accepts -999 to 999. Negative moves earlier, positive moves later, and the final value is clamped to 1-999.
“Top / Bottom” are effectively 0 and 1000 with higher priority. Use them only when a mod must be first or last.

Note: Top/bottom weights override other weight settings, including default and shifted weights.
      Weight shift is based on the normal mod weight by default. If another weight is set, shift is based on that value. Multiple shifts stack. Total weight is clamped to 1-999.

Suggested weight ranges:

[[Range]]		[[Category]]						[[Examples]]
0				Pinned top						Harmony or manual top
1 - 49			Very early frameworks			Frameworks near Harmony
50 - 99			Official content						Core, Royalty, Ideology, Anomaly
100 - 199		Common base libraries					Vanilla Expanded Framework
201 - 700		Normal gameplay/content mods		Most content mods (items, races, factions)
701 - 800		UI enhancements				RimHUD, Numbers, InventoryTab
801 - 899		Visual/audio/patches			Texture and audio replacements
900 - 949		Language/localization				LanguagePack
950 - 999		Late optimizers/logic		Rocketman, Performance Optimize
1000			Pinned bottom						Manual bottom

steam_running_conflict.message:
This environment is set to launch the game executable directly, and Workshop mods have been linked into the local mod folder.
Steam is currently running. If you continue now, Steam will take over this launch and the game will show two copies of Workshop mods.
The local-folder copy is usually loaded first, so gameplay is usually unaffected, but the in-game list and later management can become confusing.
You can quit Steam manually. This window will keep waiting and launch the game automatically after Steam fully exits.
If you understand the impact, you can continue anyway.
steam_running_conflict.title: Quit Steam first
